ppi_focus: OBD scan: stored and pending codes, readiness monitors, ECU calibration ID vs factory
Clutch engagement point, slip test in a high gear, throwout bearing noise at idle with the pedal in and out
Signs of track use: tire shoulder wear, brake pad/rotor condition, brake fluid colour, scuffs under the front lip
Oil level and condition, PCV/oil-consumption signs, leaks at the cam covers and front cover
Paint meter on all panels, especially the front end and quarters, to test the 'no accidents' history
Underside: subframe, control arms, exhaust hangers, any jacking-point damage
Tire DOT dates, matching brand/size, and alignment wear pattern
Differential and transmission fluid condition, whine or notchiness through the gears
Confirm all factory equipment works: HVAC, HomeLink mirror, heated seats
what_would_change_verdict: A price move toward the $13k–$16k fair-value range would materially improve value.
A full CARFAX plus dated service records showing regular oil and fluid service would lift documentation.
A clean independent PPI with a stock ECU calibration, a healthy clutch and no track-wear signs would lift condition.
Evidence of track use, a removed tune, a worn clutch or paint-meter evidence of an unreported repair would move it down.
evidence.mission_note: A manual, naturally aspirated, stock-appearing BRZ fits the enthusiast-bridge brief and resells easily, though it is a secondary candidate behind the Z3 3.0i. The accelerated-bridge mode does not justify paying well above comps or skipping the PPI.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity well: the VIN is listed and decodes to a 2015 BRZ 2.0L coupe with no contradictions. Photos show an apparently unmodified Crystal White Pearl Limited with factory wheels, stock exhaust and current California registration. Clean title and CARFAX one-owner status are dealer claims; the report itself is not attached. The only observed issues are a minor 10-mile mileage discrepancy in the listing text and an asking price of $18,967, above the $12,002–$16,208 sold-comp fair-value range. The 2013 valve-spring and 2018-2019 fuel-pump recalls do not apply to this model year. Track history, tune status, clutch condition, tire dates and all maintenance records remain open. The capture was limited to the saved-list card, so the dealer page may hold more.
evidence.next_action: Call Santa Barbara Auto Group to request the CARFAX, any service or reconditioning records, tire date-code photos, the out-the-door price and written permission for an independent PPI before any deposit.
